messages:
Sam: Friday LAN idea — roguelike marathon (Spelunky2 / Hades / The Binding of Isaac) at 7pm in the lounge. Bring controllers, snacks? I can bring my Switch + PS5 pad.
Anya: Ooh yes. I'm in after 8, got a late meeting. Can we do flexible drop-in?
Devon: Count me in. Also have a spare Xbox controller and a GBA link cable (why do I still own that?) if someone wants to dust off link-cable trading.
Leo: I need a controller — mine's in repair. Can I borrow the PS5 pad? @Sam
Sam: Yep @Leo you can borrow mine. Please return it by Monday :grimacing:
Jen: I can bring extra HDMI and a surge strip. Also bringing tortilla chips. :chip:
Devon: Also, quick poll — want to do a 'no-death' high-score run for prizes? Or chill rotate-on-death?
Anya: Rotate-on-death. Keeps energy up.
Leo: Agree, rotate-on-death.
Sam: OK rotate-on-death. Prize: a mystery indie key from my stash.
gamebot: Reminder — lounge booking auto-cancel at 6:45pm if not checked in. https://intranet/redwood/rooms/lounge
Jen: Good call. I'll check us in at 6:50.
Anya: PS — anyone who wants the GBA link cable for the retro corner, ping @Devon earlier, he has two.
Devon: True, also I've got a cheap CRT if we want to set up a retro corner. Needs composite cable.
Sam: Awesome. I'll add a tiny agenda in #random: 7:00 setup / 7:30 start / snack break 9pm / midnight wind-down.
Leo: Bringing earphones for Hades music mania.
Jen: Also if someone wants zero-lag input, bring wired controllers. Wireless can be flaky on the office Wi-Fi.
Anya: Thanks, all. See you Friday! :partyparrot:
Sam: Same thread: if someone needs a ride home after late finish, DM me.

Sam: Quick check-in command for whoever is on lobby duty:
```
/rooms checkin lounge 18:50
```
Jen: I'll do the check-in and I'll bring a label maker for controller names.
Devon: If anyone wants the GBA link cable earlier in the week for testing, I can leave it on my desk — message me.
Leo: Legend. See ya.
